text:
maya-sales: Quick alert  AcmePay POC just hit a flurry of 429s during a bulk import demo. We have a customer-facing session in 45m.

nate-eng: Can you paste the client error + route?

maya-sales: From their frontend logs:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 429
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1500
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 60
Retry-After: 60
{"error":"rate limit exceeded","route":"/v1/embeddings","tenant":"acmepay-poc"}
```
They ran ~50 parallel embed calls for ~100 tokens each.

Priya-ml: This is classic token-budget exhaustion on per-route limits. For batch imports we should use multi-input embeddings (single call with many inputs) to avoid per-call token overhead.

sam-ops: I can apply a temporary reservation: raise per-route token budget to 14000 tokens/min and enable queueing with max_concurrency=10 for tenant acmepay-poc, TTL=3h. Also add a short-lived waiver for warnings to prevent auto-notify.

nate-eng: Sounds good. Also add guidance to client: set concurrency to <=8 and implement exponential backoff (jitter). We'll record the pattern to recommend a production plan: either dedicated capacity or reserved quota for bulk ETL.

quota-bot: reservation created id=resv_z12c for tenant=acmepay-poc route=/v1/embeddings tokens_per_min=14000 ttl=3h by sam-ops.

maya-sales: Confirmed with customer via DM, they accept temporary bump. They're asking about pricing for sustained higher quota.

Priya-ml: For cost efficiency suggest switching to the "embed-lite" model we surfaced in docs (lower token cost per vector) for bulk imports. Also enable caching for repeated items. I'll draft a note for sales.

sam-ops: Reservation applied. Will collect metrics and revert automatically. Leaving audit note in reservation.

nate-eng: Follow-ups: document a presales checklist for import demos, include a quick-run script to batch + example client-side batching. Also track a product request: console toggle for short-term reservations for sales users (with audit).

maya-sales: Demo rerun now  looks stable, only a couple transient Retry-After spikes. Customer happy. Thanks team.
